about: The Collect recalls God’s gifts of learning and virtue to Robert, bishop and Doctor, for resisting error and defending the Apostolic See’s rights. It asks, by his merits and intercession, for our growth in love of truth and for the return of erring hearts to the Church’s unity.

seg.tr: God, You endowed blessed Robert, Your bishop and Doctor, with wonderful learning and virtue to repel the snares of error and defend the rights of the Apostolic See. By his merits and intercession, grant that we may grow in love of truth and that the hearts of those in error may return to the unity of Your Church. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

a.g: to repel the snares of error
to defend the rights of the Apostolic See
the hearts of those in error
may return to the unity of Your Church
who lives and reigns with You

ex.w004: English “error” is a collective abstract noun here. The Latin names errors in the plural and does not specify a particular person or movement.
ex.w011: The shared “to” expresses the purpose of God’s endowment: repelling the snares and defending the rights, not an independent prediction.
ex.w017: Doctor is the source heading’s title for a teacher of the Church, not a medical profession.
ex.w022: God bestowed the learning and virtue in the past. The prayer then turns to two requests for the present and future.
ex.w029: “We” is the subject of growing in love of truth. The next request has a different subject: the hearts of those in error.
ex.w035: Those in error are the people whose hearts the prayer asks to return to the unity of God’s Church.
ex.w058: “God” refers to the Son, who lives and reigns with the Father in the unity of the Holy Spirit.
